# Project Standards (ContextKit)

This project uses [ContextKit](https://github.com/nolrm/contextkit) for AI development standards.

## Project Standards

Read these files before writing code:

- `.contextkit/standards/code-style.md` — Coding conventions and style rules
- `.contextkit/standards/architecture.md` — Architecture decisions and patterns

Loaded on demand via skills, not always-loaded: testing.md (`test` skill), workflows.md (`agent-push-checklist` skill), ai-guidelines.md and glossary.md (`standards-aware` skill), decisions.md and roadmap.md (`product-context` skill).

## Product Context

- `.contextkit/product/mission-lite.md` — Product mission (condensed)

## Quick Reference

Corrections log (`.contextkit/corrections.md`) is loaded on demand via the `standards-aware` skill, not always-loaded.

Before writing code, always read the relevant standards files above. ContextKit skills are available in `.codex/skills/` — use them to run the spec and squad pipelines.

## Working on This Package

You are editing the ContextKit package source — not an installed project. The `.contextkit/` directory in this repo IS the source that gets distributed.

When modifying commands or skills, always update ALL of these locations:

| What changed | Files to update |
|---|---|
| A command (spec, squad, etc.) | `.contextkit/commands/[path]` AND `commands/[path]` (mirror) |
| A Claude skill | `.claude/skills/[name]/SKILL.md` |
| A Codex skill | `.codex/skills/[name]/SKILL.md` |
| Both skill platforms | Both `.claude/` and `.codex/` skill files |

Never update only one mirror and leave the other stale. After any command edit, confirm with `diff .contextkit/commands/[path] commands/[path]`.
